intro: The Empty Sampling Tube is a glass phial provided by Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine. It is intended to collect corrupted water from the Cliffspring River so night elf scholars can study the encroaching taint threatening Darkshore.

p: As the wilderness of Darkshore succumbs to creeping blight, the natural waterways have begun to turn foul. Thundris Windweaver, an investigator stationed in Auberdine, provides this empty glass tube to gather concrete evidence from the Cliffspring River. Drawn from the pool beneath the first waterfall north of town, the resulting sample allows night elf naturalists to examine the nature of the corruption washing toward Mist's Edge.
